MGR_MOD_SETTINGS_UI_TELEMETRY_CLEAN_RUN_: With your explicit consent, sends MGR single-player run data for balance analysis. Multiplayer runs, complete saves, player names, and logs are not sent.
MGR_MOD_SETTINGS_UI_DISABLE_CHARACTER_AN: Disables both frame-by-frame character animation and persistent effects around the character. Takes effect the next time the combat character is created.
MGR_MOD_SETTINGS_UI_DISABLE_NOTE_SOUNDS_: Mutes sounds played when Notes are generated and Chords trigger. This option is off by default and must be enabled manually.
